title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
english: A tragic fuel tanker accident on a busy Cairo highway resulted in at least 31 deaths and 21 injuries. Reports indicate the vehicle lost control and caught fire after colliding with a fallen power cable. Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which highlights ongoing concerns regarding road safety and infrastructure in the region.

title: Kim Jong Un says North Korea should widen deployment of tactical nukes
english: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has called for the expansion of his country’s tactical nuclear arsenal to better prepare for modern combat scenarios. During a recent facility inspection, he insisted that North Korea’s status as a nuclear-armed nation is non-negotiable and warned that any attempts to challenge this will be treated as an act of war. These comments follow heightening tensions with South Korea regarding a recent border incident involving landmines.

oromo: Hogganaan biyya Koriyaa Kaabaa Kim Jong Un, biyyattiin haala waraana ammayyaatiif akka qophooftuuf meeshaalee niwukilaraa iddoo adda addaatti akka babal'istu gaafataniiru. title: Photos: Storms and an El Nino-charged king tide batter California’s coast
english: Parts of the United States West Coast are facing significant flooding and damage due to record-high tides and powerful storm surges. These dangerous conditions are being driven by a combination of a strong El Nino weather pattern, climate change, and the natural phenomenon known as king tides. Local officials are urging residents to remain vigilant and prepare for additional extreme tidal events expected throughout the coming winter months.

title: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
english: Ukrainian forces recently conducted a long-range strike on the Savasleyka airbase in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region. According to Ukrainian military officials, the operation damaged five aircraft, including three MiG-31 jets and two Su-34 fighter-bombers. This attack is part of Kyiv's ongoing strategy to weaken Russia's military capabilities and infrastructure as the conflict continues.
amharic: የዩክሬን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሩሲያ ኒዝሂ ኖቭጎሮድ ግዛት በሚገኘው የሳቫስሌይካ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። የዩክሬን ወታደራዊ መረጃ እንደገለጸው፣ ጥቃቱ ሶስት ሚግ-31 ጄቶችን እና ሁለት የሱ-34 ተዋጊ አውሮፕላኖችን ጨምሮ በአምስት የሩሲያ አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ይህ እርምጃ ኪየቭ የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ አቅም ለማዳከም እየወሰደች ካለችው የረጅም ርቀት ጥቃቶች አንዱ አካል ነው።

Haleellaan kun tarsiimoo Yukreen kan humna waraana Raashiyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa ishee laaffisuuf itti fayyadamaa jirtu keessaa isa tokko.

title: ICE officers smash car window, pepper spray bystanders
english: Masked ICE agents forcibly arrested a man near a sheriff's station in Santa Clarita, California, by shattering his car window. During the operation, officers used pepper spray on people who were recording the arrest and questioning their aggressive tactics. This incident has drawn attention due to the confrontational methods employed by the federal agents.

title: Judges recommend prosecutors end corruption case against Netanyahu
english: Israeli judges have suggested that prosecutors drop the ongoing corruption trial against Benjamin Netanyahu, citing a low likelihood of a conviction. The Prime Minister has consistently argued that the decade-long legal proceedings are driven by political motives rather than evidence. This recommendation marks a significant potential turning point for the long-standing case.

title: Could renewed strikes on Hodeidah port worsen Yemen’s humanitarian crisis?
english: The Saudi-led coalition has resumed airstrikes on the Hodeidah port in Yemen, aiming to counter recent territorial gains and attacks by Houthi forces. As the country's primary gateway for essential goods and humanitarian aid, the port is vital for millions living in northern regions. Experts warn that further damage to this facility will likely worsen the existing humanitarian crisis by disrupting the delivery of food, fuel, and medical supplies.

title: Houthis say Saudi-led coalition carries out 105 air strikes in 24 hours

title: UK moving military planes into hangars amid drone threat: reports
english: The British Royal Air Force is taking measures to safeguard its aircraft by placing them in secure hangars and installing anti-drone nets to defend against potential aerial threats. The government is also allocating an additional £470 million to enhance security infrastructure and surveillance at military installations across the country. These actions reflect ongoing official concerns regarding foreign threats, prompting the military to proactively update its defense strategies.
amharic: የብሪታንያ አየር ኃይል በአውሮፕላኖቹ ላይ ሊደርሱ የሚችሉ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ሲል፣ አውሮፕላኖቹን ወደ ተጠበቁ ቦታዎች በማስገባት እና መረቦችን በመዘርጋት ላይ ይገኛል። መንግሥትም ለወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ደህንነት እና ለክትትል ስራዎች የሚውል ተጨማሪ 470 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ መድቧል። እነዚህ ጥንቃቄዎች የሚወሰዱት ከውጭ ሀገራት የሚመጡ ስጋቶችን ለመቋቋም እና የሀገሪቱን የመከላከያ አቅም ለማዘመን ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni qilleensa biyya Ingilizii, xiyyaara isaanii miidhaa roopii (drone) irraa ittisuuf jecha bakka gaachana qabutti galchuufi akkasumas maroo ittisaa diriirsuuf hojjechaa jiru. Mootummaan biyyattii buufataalee waraanaa isaanii cimsuufi hordoffii fooyyessuuf maallaqa paawundii miiliyoona 470 dabalataa ramadeera. Tarkaanfileen kun kan fudhataman sodaa biyyoota alaa irraa dhuuu danda'u of irraa ittisuufi qophii waraana isaanii hammayyeessuufi.

title: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery in retaliation for deadly strikes
english: Houthi rebels have launched an attack on Saudi Arabia's primary oil refinery, Ras Tanura, resulting in fires at the facility. This strike was declared as a retaliatory action following Saudi military operations in Yemen that killed at least 26 civilians. The group stated the assault was intended to respond to recent attacks on civilian vehicles and infrastructure across several Yemeni regions.
amharic: የሁቲ አማፂያን በሳውዲ አረቢያ ትልቁ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋም በሆነው ራስ ታኑራ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በየመን ሳውዲ አረቢያ ባደረሰችው እና ቢያንስ 26 ንፁሃን ዜጎች በተገደሉበት የአየር ድብደባ ምክንያት በቀል መውሰድ እንደሆነ ቡድኑ ገልጿል። የሁቲ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት እርምጃው የተወሰደው በሲቪል መኪኖች እና መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ለተፈጸሙ የሳውዲ ጥቃቶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው።
oromo: Houthonni ergamtoota Yemen irraa ta'an, buufata qulqulleessa boba'aa guddaa Saudii Araabiyaa kan ta'e Ras Tanura irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, duula waraana Saudii kan Yemen keessatti namoota nagaa 26 ol ajjeeseef haaloo ba'uuf akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Gareen kun akka jedhutti, haleellaan kun imalaannee fi qabeenya ummataa irratti haleellaa Saudiin raawwatteef deebii kan kennu dha.

title: Russia's own figures show it has lost almost 500,000 people in Ukraine war
english: Leaked official data analyzed by the BBC indicates that nearly 500,000 Russian soldiers have died since the invasion of Ukraine began in 2022. The records reveal that the war has become the leading cause of death for young Russian men, significantly impacting the country's demographic patterns. Experts suggest the true death toll could be even higher, as the conflict continues to claim thousands of lives for minor territorial gains.
amharic: ቢቢሲ ይፋ ባደረገው የተለቀቀ የመንግስት መረጃ መሠረት፣ ከ2022 ጀምሮ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጉ የሩሲያ ወታደሮች መሞታቸው ታውቋል። ይህ ጦርነት በሩሲያ ወጣት ወንዶች መካከል ዋነኛው የሞት መንስኤ በመሆን የሀገሪቱን የህዝብ ቁጥር ስብጥር ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ ጦርነቱ ለአነስተኛ መሬት ግዢ በሚያደርገው ፍልሚያ በርካታ ህይወቶችን እየቀጠፈ በመሆኑ፣ ትክክለኛው የሟቾች ቁጥር ከዚህም በላይ ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon mootummaa biyyattii irraa hatamee bahe kan BBC’n qoratame akka agarsiisutti, waraana Yukreenii kan bara 2022 jalqabeen loltoonni Raashiyaa gara 500,000 ta’an du’aniiru. Ragaan kun waraanni kun dargaggoota Raashiyaa gidduutti sababa guddaa du’aa ta’ee akka jiruufi caasaa namoota biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa akka jiru ibsa. Ogeeyyoonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni kun lafa xiqqoo qabachuuf jedhee lubbuu namoota baay'ee waan galaafatuuf, baay'inni namoota du'anii ragaa kana caalaa ta'uu danda'a.

title: Four years after huge asteroid crash, a spacecraft has now returned to assess the damage
english: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has arrived at the Dimorphos asteroid to study the lasting effects of a 2022 NASA crash test. This mission aims to analyze the crater and physical changes caused when the DART spacecraft intentionally collided with the rock to divert its orbit. By examining the impact site, scientists hope to refine planetary defense strategies for protecting Earth against future asteroid threats.
amharic: የአውሮፓ የጠፈር ምርምር ኤጀንሲ ሄራ የተሰኘው መንኮራኩር በ2022 ናሳ በአስትሮይድ ላይ ባደረገው የሙከራ ግጭት የተፈጠረውን ውጤት ለመመልከት ዲሞርፎስ የተባለውን አስትሮይድ ደርሷል። የዚህ ተልዕኮ ዓላማ የናሳ መንኮራኩር አስትሮይዱን ከምህዋሩ ለማስወጣት ባደረገው ግጭት በድንጋዩ ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት እና የቅርጽ ለውጥ ማጥናት ነው። ተመራማሪዎች ይህንን መረጃ በመጠቀም ወደፊት ምድርን ሊያሰጋ የሚችል አስትሮይድ ቢኖር እንዴት መከላከል እንደሚቻል የተሻለ እቅድ ለማውጣት ይጠቀሙበታል።
oromo: Ejensii Qorannoo Hawaa Awurooppaa kan ta'e 'Hera', asataroyidii Dimorphos jedhamu irra ga'uun, bara 2022 mootummaan Ameerikaa (NASA) qormaata ittisa lafaa geggeesse booda miidhaan qaqqabe maal akka fakkaatu qorachuu jalqabeera. Ergamaan kun, meeshaan hawaa DART asataroyidicha karaa isaa irraa maqsuuf itti bu'e sanaan booda, haalli dirra asataroyidichaa jijjiiramuu isaa hubachuuf gargaara. Qorannoon kun gara fuulduraatti asataroyidii lafaaf balaa ta'u danda'u tokko akkamitti fageessuu akka danda'amuuf gorsa saayinsii nuuf kenna.

title: The rising cost of putting food on the table in India
english: India is currently facing a sharp increase in food inflation, which reached nearly 9% in October due to unpredictable weather and supply chain issues. These rising costs are putting a significant financial burden on families, forcing many to cut back on leisure spending and purchase smaller quantities of basic goods. Economists note that because food remains a major part of the average Indian budget, this situation is creating serious economic and social challenges for the country.
amharic: ህንድ በአሁኑ ወቅት ባልተጠበቀ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና በአቅርቦት ችግሮች ምክንያት የምግብ ዋጋ ንረት ወደ 9 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ እያሳየች ነው። ይህ የዋጋ ጭማሪ በቤተሰቦች ላይ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና በመፍጠሩ፣ ብዙዎች ከመዝናኛ ወጪዎቻቸውን በመቀነስ እና መሰረታዊ የፍጆታ ዕቃዎችን በመቀነስ እንዲኖሩ አስገድዷቸዋል። የምግብ ወጪ በአማካይ የህንድ ቤተሰቦች በጀት ውስጥ ትልቅ ድርሻ ስላለው፣ ይህ ሁኔታ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ከባድ ማህበራዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ተግዳሮቶችን እያስከተለ መሆኑን የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Indiyaan amma qilleensa tasgabbii hin qabnee fi rakkoo dhiyeessii midhaan nyaataa irraa kan ka'e, gatiin nyaataa gara dhibbeentaa 9tti ol guddatee jira. Nyaanni baajata maatiiwwan Indiyaa keessatti qooda guddaa waan qabuuf, rakkoon kun biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee fi hawaasummaa cimaa uumaa jiraachuu ogeeyyoonni diinagdee ibsu.

title: See motorcycle passenger’s viral cricket catch
english: A video featuring a motorcycle passenger successfully catching a cricket ball has become a viral sensation online. The footage highlights the unusual and impressive reflexes of the passenger while riding through traffic. Social media users have widely shared the clip due to the surprising nature of the event.

oromo: Namichi mooraa mootsaayikilii irra taa'e tokko kubbaa kriketii qilleensa irraa qabate tokko vidiyoon isaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti baay'ee namatti toleera. title: Dozens of ports close as powerful waves damage Peru’s coastline
english: Peruvian officials have shut down many ports due to intense ocean swells that have caused damage to coastal structures. The country's navy attributes these dangerous sea conditions to the ongoing El Nino weather phenomenon. Authorities are keeping the ports closed temporarily to ensure safety while the rough seas persist.
amharic: የፔሩ ባለሥልጣናት በባህር ዳርቻው ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ ኃይለኛ ማዕበሎች በመከሰታቸው በርካታ ወደቦችን በጊዜያዊነት ዘግተዋል። የሀገሪቱ የባህር ኃይል እነዚህን አደገኛ የባህር ሁኔታዎች ከኤል ኒኖ የአየር ሁኔታ ጋር አያይዞታል። ማዕበሉ እስኪረጋጋ ድረስ የህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ወደቦቹ ተዘግተው እንዲቆዩ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa Peru dhiibbaa gurguddaa qarqara galaanaatti miidhaa geessise hordofee, buufataaleen markabaa hedduun yeroof akka cufaman taasisaniiru. Raayyaan ittisa biyyattii haala qilleensa hamaa kana kan walqabsiise mul'ata 'El Nino' waliini. Buufataaleen kun hanga haalli qilleensichaa foyya'utti nageenya eeguuf cufamanii turu.

title: ‘We need to be seen’: Over a third of UK Muslim students face Islamophobia
english: A recent report by the Federation of Student Islamic Societies reveals that over one-third of Muslim students in the UK have encountered Islamophobia on university campuses. Female students are particularly vulnerable to these incidents, which range from verbal abuse and insults to physical harassment. Many victims feel unsupported by their institutions, leading to a growing call for universities to take more decisive action against discrimination.
amharic: የተማሪዎች እስላማዊ ማህበራት ፌዴሬሽን ይፋ ባደረገው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ ከሶስት ሙስሊም ተማሪዎች በላይ የሚሆኑት በግቢ ውስጥ እስላሞፎቢያ ወይም የእስልምና ጥላቻ እንደገጠማቸው ተገልጿል። በተለይም ሴት ተማሪዎች ከቃል ስድብ እስከ አካላዊ ጥቃት ድረስ ባሉ አድልዎዎች የመጋለጥ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ መሆኑ ተመላክቷል። በርካታ ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ተቋማቱ ለችግሩ ተገቢውን ትኩረት እንዳልሰጡ በመግለጽ፣ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች መድልዎን ለመከላከል ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa 'Federation of Student Islamic Societies' baase akka agarsiisutti, barattoonni Muslimaa UK keessa jiran tokko sadaffaa ol ta'an yunivarsitii keessatti jibba amantii (Islamophobia) irra ga'aa akka jiru ibseera. Keessattuu barattoonni dubartoonni arrabsamuufi miidhaa qaamaa irra ga'uuf saaxilamoo ta'uun isaanii beekameera. Barattoonni hedduun dhaabbileen barnootaa deeggarsa barbaachisu akka hin goone ibsuun, yunivarsitiin gidirsuu fi loogii kana dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan gaafachaa jiru.

title: Two Libyan soldiers die after Ukraine attack on Russian vessel
english: Two Libyan naval officers have passed away following a Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian warship docked near Benghazi. Libya's eastern-based military forces, which maintain close ties with Russia, have vowed to retaliate for the attack. Ukraine has confirmed its responsibility for the operation, while France expressed support, describing the action as a legitimate exercise of Ukraine's right to self-defense.

title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
english: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, Carla Bruni, will stand trial next year regarding accusations of witness tampering. Authorities believe the couple attempted to discredit a key witness who had previously alleged that Sarkozy received illegal campaign funding from the late Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi. Both Sarkozy and Bruni maintain their innocence, even as the former president continues to face multiple ongoing legal challenges related to his political activities.

title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
english: A US jury has convicted Huawei of multiple charges, including stealing trade secrets, bank fraud, and violating international sanctions. While the company was found guilty on 10 out of 12 counts, jurors acquitted the tech giant of the more severe racketeering charges. Huawei officials expressed relief regarding the racketeering acquittal, maintaining that their business success is the result of genuine innovation rather than criminal activity.

title: Gunmen hold dozens hostage in Colombia supermarket
english: A group of armed individuals has taken about 20 people hostage inside a supermarket in Cartagena, Colombia. The situation began after an attempted robbery failed, forcing the suspects to hide in the store. The gunmen are currently requesting a payment of nearly $2 million in exchange for the safe release of the hostages.

title: Alaska ends deal to give voter records to US Justice Department
english: Alaska has officially canceled an agreement that allowed the U.S. Department of Justice to access its state voter records. Lieutenant Governor Nancy Dahlstrom stated the deal is no longer necessary now that the 2026 midterm elections have concluded. Throughout the agreement, federal officials never identified any ineligible voters or raised concerns about the state's registration data.

title: Iran war live: Houthis threaten Saudi ports over coalition’s Hodeidah order
english: Tensions in the region have escalated after a Saudi-led coalition ordered civilians to evacuate the Yemeni port of Hodeidah, leading the Houthi group to threaten retaliatory attacks on Saudi ports. Furthermore, the head of Iran's Revolutionary Guard warned that potential conflicts could spread globally and urged regional neighbors to reduce their security cooperation with the United States. This situation highlights the growing instability surrounding key maritime trade routes and international military alliances.

title: Rebel group retreats in DR Congo after heavy clashes with government forces
english: A rebel group led by Thomas Lubanga has pulled its fighters back from recently occupied territories in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. This retreat follows intense confrontations with government soldiers near the city of Bunia. The decision to withdraw was attributed to agreements reached during peace discussions mediated by the Ugandan government.

title: South Africa convicts Zimbabwean who tried to fight Ukraine for Russia
english: A South African court has sentenced a Zimbabwean man to a five-year suspended prison term after he admitted to attempting to travel to Russia to work as a mercenary. Tafadzwa Sithole was arrested at a Johannesburg airport while preparing to fly to Russia, having been recruited online for payment to join the war against Ukraine. He pleaded guilty to violating laws that ban mercenary activities and will now be deported back to his home country.

title: ‘Unfinished Beginnings’: Art installation for children affected by war
english: Artist Bachir Mohamad has created a powerful art installation in Doha titled 'Unfinished Beginnings,' which features 20,000 baby bottles. This exhibit aims to draw attention to the suffering of children impacted by conflict, hunger, and displacement. The project serves as a fundraiser for Qatar Charity and promotes the urgent message that war should not be the reality for any child.
amharic: አርቲስት ባሺር መሀመድ በዶሃ 'ያልተጠናቀቁ ጅማሬዎች' በሚል ርዕስ 20,000 የሕፃናት ወተት ጠርሙሶችን በመጠቀም አዲስ የጥበብ ሥራ አቅርቧል። ይህ ኤግዚቢሽን በጦርነት፣ በረሃብ እና ከመኖሪያቸው በተፈናቀሉ ህፃናት ላይ የሚደርሰውን ችግር ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው። ፕሮጀክቱ ለኳታር በጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት ገንዘብ በማሰባሰብ ላይ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ማንኛውም ህፃን የጦርነት ሰለባ መሆን የለበትም የሚለውን መልእክት ያስተላልፋል።
oromo: Artist Bachir Mohamad Doha keessatti 'Jalqaba Hin Xumuramne' mata duree jedhuun, qodaa aannanii ijoollee 20,000 fayyadamuun hojii ogummaa tokko dhiyeesseera. Hojichi ijoollee waraana, beelaa fi buqqaatiin miidhaman irratti xiyyeeffata. Kaayyoon isaa gargaarsa 'Qatar Charity'f maallaqa walitti qabuu fi ijoolleen kamiyyuu waraana dhaaluu akka hin qabne dhaamsa dabarsuu dha.

title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
english: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO shortly after he was forced to resign due to a scandal involving alleged links to Chinese intelligence. Donald Trump claimed credit for influencing the company's board to bring Huang back, sparking significant criticism from lawmakers. Despite the controversy, the announcement caused Nvidia's stock value to surge by nearly $1 trillion, helping to stabilize the broader market.
amharic: ኤንቪዲያ የኩባንያውን ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና የስለላ ድርጅት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ከተባለበት ቅሌት በኋላ ስራቸውን ለቀው እንደነበር ቢታወቅም አሁን ወደ ስልጣናቸው መልሰዋቸዋል። ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኩባንያው ቦርድ ሁአንግን እንዲመልሱ ለማሳመን ሚና እንደነበራቸው መናገራቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ውዝግቡ ቢኖርም የሁአንግ ወደ ስልጣን መመለስ የኩባንያውን የገበያ ዋጋ በአንድ ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በማሳደግ የአክሲዮን ገበያውን ለማረጋጋት ችሏል።
oromo: Nvidia hojii geggeessaa isaanii Jensen Huang, walitti dhufeenya iccitii Chaayinaa wajjin qabaachuu isaatiin walqabatee dirqisiisanii hojiirraa er gaggeessanii booda, ammas gara hojiitti deebisaniiru. Donald Traamp hojiin kun akka deebi'uuf boordii dhaabbatichaa kan amansiise ofii isaanii ta'uu dubbachuun isaanii mormii cimaa siyaasaa isaan mudateera. Mormii kana hunda waliin, deebiin Huang gabaa aksiyoonaa dhaabbatichaa gara tiriliyoona tokkoon ol kan guddisse yoo ta'u, gabaa waliigalaas tasgabbeessuuf gargaareera.

title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
english: Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte has pledged to protect alliance territory following reports that Russia may be planning to deploy a nuclear-armed satellite in space. German media outlets claim this potential weapon, allegedly named Sputnik-S, could be used to disable critical communication and observation satellites. While the Kremlin has dismissed these allegations as propaganda, Nato officials have confirmed they are reviewing their defense strategies to counter such potential threats.
amharic: የኔቶ ዋና ጸሐፊ ማርክ ሩቴ፣ ሩሲያ በህዋ ላይ የኒውክሌር መሣሪያ የታጠቀ ሳተላይት ልታሰማራ ትችላለች የሚል ዘገባ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ አሊያንሱ አካባቢውን እንደሚከላከል አስታውቀዋል። የጀርመን መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት ከሆነ ስፑትኒክ-ኤስ የተሰኘው ይህ የሩሲያ ሳተላይት ወሳኝ የመገናኛ እና የክትትል ሳተላይቶችን የማውደም አቅም አለው። የሩሲያ መንግሥት ውንጀላውን የፕሮፓጋንዳ ዘመቻ በማለት ውድቅ ቢያደርግም፣ ኔቶ ይህንን ስጋት ለመመከት የመከላከያ ስልቶቹን እየገመገመ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል።
oromo: Hogganaan Nato Maark Ruute, Raashiyaan satalaayitii meeshaa niwukilera hidhatee gara hawaatti erguuf karoorfachuu ishee ilaalchisee gabaasota baʼan hordofee, Nato naannawa isaa kamiyyuu akka ittisu waadaa galeera. Miidiyaaleen Jarman akka gabaasanitti, satalaayitiin 'Sputnik-S' jedhamu kun satalaayitoota qunnamtii fi hordoffii barbaachisoo taʼan miidhuu ykn balleessuu dandaʼa jedhamee sodaatama. Raashiyaan himannaa kana duula propagandaa jechuun kan haalte taʼus, Nato xiyyeeffannoo cimaa kennee ittisa isaa ammayyeessaa akka jiru beeksiseera.

title: India's 'cockroach' party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
english: Saurav Das, a prominent leader of India's youth-led 'Cockroach' party, was prevented from boarding a flight to the UK at Delhi airport. Officials stated his passport had been flagged, though the specific reason for this action remains unconfirmed. Das claims the government blocked his trip to prevent him from delivering lectures at prestigious universities like Oxford, Cambridge, and Edinburgh.
amharic: የህንድ ወጣት የፖለቲካ ቡድን መሪ የሆኑት ሳውራቭ ዳስ ከኒው ዴሊ አየር ማረፊያ ወደ እንግሊዝ እንዳይበሩ ተከልክለዋል። የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ፓስፖርታቸው ላይ ችግር እንዳለ በመግለጽ ጉዟቸውን እንዳቆሙት ቢናገሩም፣ ትክክለኛው ምክንያት ግን አልታወቀም። ዳስ በበኩላቸው መንግስት በኦክስፎርድ እና በካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ንግግር እንዳያደርጉ ሆን ብሎ እንደከለከላቸው በመግለጽ ይከሳሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii dargaggootaa Hindii kan 'Cockroach' jedhamu kan ta'an Saurav Das, buufata xiyyaaraa Deelii irraa gara UK akka hin deemne dhoorkamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni imigrationii paaspoortiin isaanii mallattoo of keessaa qaba jedhanii akka deeman hin heyyamneef, ta'us sababni isaa ifa hin taane. Das mootummaan barnoota dhaabbilee akka Oksford fi Kaambirijitti akka hin kennineef jecha akka isaan dhoorke himataniiru.

title: Pennsylvania reports ninth measles death in ongoing state outbreak
english: Pennsylvania has confirmed its ninth death from an ongoing measles outbreak that has affected 46 counties across the state. With over 1,600 cases recorded, local health officials are reporting higher mortality figures than the CDC due to differences in how federal and state agencies track these deaths. This outbreak is part of a larger national crisis, as the United States has officially lost its measles-elimination status following the highest number of infections since 1991.
amharic: ፔንስልቬንያ በግዛቷ እየተስፋፋ ባለው የኩፍኝ በሽታ ዘጠነኛውን የሞት አጋጣሚ አረጋግጣለች። በ46 ወረዳዎች ውስጥ ከ1,600 በላይ ጉዳዮች የተመዘገቡ ሲሆን፣ በፌደራል እና በግዛት ኤጀንሲዎች መካከል ባለው የመረጃ አያያዝ ልዩነት ምክንያት የሟቾች ቁጥር በተለያዩ ሪፖርቶች ላይ ተለያይቶ ይታያል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በአሜሪካ አገራዊ ቀውስ ሆኗል፤ ከ1991 ወዲህ ከፍተኛው የኢንፌክሽን ቁጥር በመመዝገቡ አገሪቱ የኩፍኝ በሽታን ሙሉ በሙሉ የማጥፋት ዕውቅናዋን አጥታለች።
oromo: Pensilveeniyaatti dhibeen kofii hammaatee namoota sagal ajjeeseera; dhibee kunis godinaalee 46 keessatti babal'atee argameera. Namoonni 1,600 ol ta'an dhukkubichaan qabamanii jiru. Maddi oduu fi qaamni fayyaa biyyoolessaa (CDC) lakkoobsa du'aa irratti walii galuu dhabuu irraan kan ka'e, ragaan gandaa fi federaalaa wal hin simatu. Amerikaan bara 1991 booda lakkoobsa namoota dhibee kofii qabamanii baay'inaan erga galmeessitee booda, dhibee kanaan bilisa ta'uu ishee sadarkaa addunyaatti dhabdeetti.

title: Danish court backs ‘ghetto law’ used to evict ‘non-Western’ residents
english: Denmark's Supreme Court has upheld a controversial policy known as the 'ghetto law,' which permits the eviction of residents from neighborhoods with large minority populations. The government claims this initiative is intended to encourage better social integration. However, the ruling solidifies the legal authority to relocate individuals based on the demographic composition of their housing areas.
amharic: የዴንማርክ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት 'ጌቶ ህግ' በሚል የሚታወቀውንና አናሳ ማህበረሰቦች በሚበዙባቸው አካባቢዎች የሚኖሩ ሰዎችን ለማፈናቀል የሚያስችለውን አወዛጋቢ ህግ አጽድቋል። መንግስት ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ማህበረሰባዊ መስተጋብርን ለማሻሻል ነው ሲል ይከራከራል። የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ በመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች ስብጥር ላይ ተመስርቶ ሰዎችን ለማዛወር መንግስት ያለውን ህጋዊ ስልጣን ያጸናል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Denmark, 'seera ghetto' jedhamu kan namoota baay'ina sanyii adda addaa qaban iddoo jireenyaa isaanii irraa buqqisuuf gargaaruuf seera qabeessa ta'uu isaa murteesseera. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame walitti makamuu hawaasaa fooyyessuufi. Haa ta'u malee, murtiin kun mootummaan gosa namoota iddoo tokko jiraatanirratti hunda'ee uummata buqqisuuf aangoo akka qabu mirkaneesseera.

title: Car bomb strikes governor’s office in Meta, Colombia
english: A car bomb detonated outside the governor's office in Villavicencio, located in the Meta Department of Colombia. The explosion resulted in significant structural damage to surrounding properties. Authorities are currently assessing the impact of the attack.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ሜታ ግዛት ቪላቪሴንሲዮ ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኘው የአስተዳዳሪው ቢሮ አቅራቢያ የመኪና ቦምብ ፈንድቷል። ፍንዳታው በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ሕንፃዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ባለሥልጣናት የደረሰውን ጉዳት መጠን በመገምገም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kolombiyaa, kutaa biyyaa Meetaa magaalaa Viilaviiseensiyootti, waajjira bulchaa biratti konkolaataan boombii hidhatame dhoheera. Dhoohaan kun manneen naannichatti argaman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Abbootiin taayitaa miidhaa dhoohaan kun geessise hordofaa jiru.

title: India’s best known bottled water under scrutiny
english: Indian authorities are conducting safety tests on all bottled water brands following reports that a batch of Bisleri, the nation’s leading water company, failed quality standards. The brand has publicly rejected these findings, asserting that its products remain completely safe for consumers. This move has prompted a widespread regulatory review to ensure water safety across the country.
amharic: የሕንድ ባለሥልጣናት የሀገሪቱ ታዋቂ የውኃ ምርት የሆነው ቢስሌሪ አንዱ ምርታቸው የደህንነት መስፈርቱን አላሟላም መባሉን ተከትሎ፣ በሁሉም የታሸጉ ውኃ አምራች ድርጅቶች ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ኩባንያው የቀረበውን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ ምርቶቹ ለተጠቃሚዎች ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ ሁኔታ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የውኃ ጥራትን ለማረጋገጥ ሰፊ የቁጥጥር ሥራ እንዲጀመር አድርጓል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Indiyaa, bishaan dhugaatii biyyattii keessatti baay'ee beekamaa ta'e 'Bisleri' jedhamu qulqullina akka hin qabne erga ibsamee booda, warshaalee bishaan dhugaatii hunda irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Kompaniin kun himannicha waakkatee, bishaan isaa fayyaa namootaaf miidhaa akka hin qabne mirkaneesseera. title: WHO chief visits Cuba as healthcare system deteriorates
english: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Cuba to evaluate the country's declining healthcare system. The nation is struggling with severe shortages of medical supplies and equipment due to an economic crisis exacerbated by United States energy sanctions. This three-day visit aims to address the challenges facing a system that was previously known for high-quality universal care.

Daawwannaan guyyaa sadii kun, sirna fayyaa durii beekamtii qabu ture kan amma rakkoo keessa jiruuf furmaata barbaaduuf kan gaggeeffamu dha.

title: Israel likely to lose Gaza genocide case if ICJ follows Myanmar ruling, Tel Aviv scholar says
english: An Israeli legal scholar warns that Israel faces a high risk of losing the genocide case brought by South Africa at the International Court of Justice. The expert notes that the court's recent ruling against Myanmar regarding the Rohingya provides a dangerous legal precedent for Israel. He argues that the current Israeli government is largely responsible for this situation due to its own actions and rhetoric during the ongoing conflict.

title: Watch: Three people killed in Israeli strike near police outpost in Gaza’s Khan Younis
english: At least three Palestinians were killed and five others were injured following an Israeli airstrike near a police station in Khan Younis, southern Gaza. This attack is part of a broader trend of violence, with officials reporting over 1,600 deaths and 5,000 injuries since the ceasefire was declared. The incident adds to the ongoing casualties resulting from frequent military actions in the region.

title: Israeli army storms Syrian village
english: Israeli military forces recently carried out operations inside Syrian territory, including searching homes in the village of Abidin. Additionally, troops established a security checkpoint in the Quneitra governorate to inspect local residents. These actions represent a notable increase in military activity within the region.

title: Iran vows to use 'all avaliable tools' to confront US naval blockade
english: Iran has promised to utilize every resource available to challenge the United States' naval restrictions on its oil exports, which were recently reimposed following the failure of a diplomatic agreement. Tensions have further escalated due to mutual accusations of military strikes, including reports of Iranian drone and missile attacks on American bases. Tehran characterizes the blockade as an act of aggression that it refuses to accept.

title: Israeli strike kills at least three Palestinians in southern Gaza
english: An Israeli military air strike in the Khan Younis area of southern Gaza resulted in the deaths of at least three Palestinians. title: Ethiopia Needs Political Reconciliation, Not Another Military Victory
english: Former U.S. Ambassador to Ethiopia Tibor Nagy argues that Ethiopia should prioritize national reconciliation over military solutions to address its internal challenges. Drawing from his long-standing diplomatic experience, Nagy cautions Ethiopians against assuming that the U.S. government is constantly focused on their nation, noting that Washington manages diverse global interests. He emphasizes that while Ethiopia remains a significant regional power, domestic stability must be achieved through political dialogue rather than external or military reliance.

title: US states sue SpaceX over Grok AI’s creation of child sexual abuse material
english: The U.S. states of Virginia and Oregon have filed lawsuits against SpaceX, alleging that its AI chatbot, Grok, lacks proper safety features. The states claim the company intentionally marketed a 'spicy mode' that allows users to create unauthorized sexualized images of people, violating consumer protection laws. Officials argue that the company prioritized business growth over public safety by removing necessary safeguards, and they are now seeking legal penalties against the firm.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች የሆኑት ቨርጂኒያ እና ኦሪገን፣ የኤሎን ማስክ ኩባንያ የሆነው ስፔስ ኤክስ (SpaceX) የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት ቴክኖሎጂ የሆነው ግሮክ (Grok) በቂ የደህንነት ጥበቃ እንደሌለው በመግለጽ ክስ መስርተዋል። ኩባንያው ተጠቃሚዎች የሰዎችን ምስል በመጠቀም የወሲብ ይዘት ያላቸውን ምስሎች እንዲፈጥሩ የሚያስችል 'ስፓይሲ ሞድ' የተባለ አማራጭ በማቅረቡ የሸማቾችን መብት እንደጣሰ ክሱ ያመለክታል። የሁለቱ ግዛቶች ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህጎች ኩባንያው ለትርፍ ሲል የደህንነት መስፈርቶችን ችላ ብሏል በሚል የገንዘብ ቅጣት እና ህጋዊ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድበት እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummoonni naannoo Virjiniyaa fi Oregon Yuunaayitid Isteetis, dhaabbata SpaceX kan Elon Musk irratti himata bananiiru. Himatichi akka jedhutti, teeknooloojii 'Grok' kan jedhamu kun eeggannoo ga’aa kan hin qabne ta’uu fi fayyadamtoonni suuraa namootaatti fayyadamuun suuraa qaama saalaa mul’isan akka oomishan kan jajjabeessu 'spicy mode' jedhamu kan qabu ta’uu ibsa. Dhimmi kun seera eeggumsa fayyadamtootaa kan cabsu ta’uu fi dhaabbatichi bu’aa qofaaf jecha eeggannoo barbaachisaa ta’e akka hin goone himatichi ni dubbata.

title: US drug prices leave patients facing impossible choices
english: Many Americans with chronic illnesses are struggling to afford necessary medications despite being employed and having health insurance. Patients like Sarah Wisniewski often face extreme hardships, including the potential rationing of life-saving drugs due to exorbitant out-of-pocket costs and insurance coverage denials. Data shows that a large percentage of adults in the U.S. have skipped medical treatments because they could not bear the high financial burden.
amharic: ብዙ አሜሪካውያን ሥር የሰደደ የጤና ችግር ያለባቸው ሰዎች ስራ ቢኖራቸውም እና የጤና ኢንሹራንስ ቢኖራቸውም አስፈላጊውን መድሃኒት ለመግዛት ይቸገራሉ። እንደ ሳራ ዊስኒውስኪ ያሉ ታካሚዎች መድሃኒቶች በጣም ውድ በመሆናቸው ወይም ኢንሹራንሳቸው ለመሸፈን ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኑ ምክንያት ሕይወት አድን መድሃኒቶችን ለመቀነስ ወይም ላለመውሰድ ይገደዳሉ። መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ብዙ ቁጥር ያላቸው የአሜሪካ ነዋሪዎች ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ጫና ስላለባቸው የታዘዘላቸውን መድሃኒት መውሰድ ተስኗቸዋል።
oromo: Namoonni Ameerikaa keessa jiraatan hedduun dhukkuba cimaa irraa kan ka'e, hojii fi inshuraansii fayyaa qabaatanis qoricha barbaachisu bitachuu irratti rakkoo guddaa qunnamaniiru. Akka Sara Wisniewski jiran kanneen, qorichi baay'ee mi’aawaa ta'uu ykn inshuraansiin dhoorguu irraa kan ka'e, qoricha lubbuu oolchu hir'isanii fudhachuuf dirqamu. Ragaan akka agarsiisutti, Ameerikaa keessatti namoonni baay'een baasii fayyaa baasuun itti ulfaatee qoricha isaanif ajajame osoo hin fudhatin hafu.

title: Five takeaways from the failed climate talks COP31
english: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey ended without a central agreement due to deep geopolitical divisions and intense disagreements over fossil fuels and funding. This failure marks a significant setback, as the summit was unable to address the reality that global temperatures are set to exceed the critical 1.5C threshold. Consequently, the lack of a final consensus has led many to question the ongoing effectiveness of the COP process in driving meaningful climate action.
amharic: በቱርክ የተካሄደው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ፣ በአገራት መካከል በተፈጠረ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ልዩነት እና በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆችና በገንዘብ ድጋፍ ዙሪያ በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ስምምነት ላይ ሳይደርስ ተጠናቀቀ። ዓለም አቀፍ የሙቀት መጠን ከ1.5 ዲግሪ ሴንቲግሬድ በላይ ሊጨምር መሆኑን አምኖ መቀበል ባለመቻሉ፣ ይህ ውድቀት ለአየር ንብረት ጥረቶች ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኗል። በጉባኤው ውጤት ማጣት ምክንያት፣ የCOP ሂደት ለወደፊት ውጤታማ የአየር ንብረት እርምጃዎችን መውሰድ ይችል እንደሆነ ጥያቄዎች እየተነሱ ነው።
oromo: Gubaa'iin jijjiirama qilleensaa COP31 biyya Turkii keessatti geggeeffame, garaagarummaa siyaasaa gadi fagoo fi dhimma boba'aa lafa keessaa akkasumas maallaqa irratti walii galtee dhabuurraa kan ka'e, waldhabdee guddaan xumurameera. Hojiiwwan jijjiirama qilleensaa kanaan dura ta'eefii turan keessatti ho'inni addunyaa daangaa 1.5C darbuu isaa fudhachuu dadhabuun isaa kufaatii guddaa ta'eera. Kufaatiin walii galtee kanaa, adeemsi COP gara fuulduraatti jijjiirama bu'a qabeessa fiduu danda'a moo kan jedhu irratti shakkii guddaa uumeera.

title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
english: A seven-year-old boy and a 79-year-old woman were rescued from the debris of a residential building in the Kyiv region following a Russian airstrike that killed 11 people. Emergency teams are continuing search and rescue operations across multiple areas affected by widespread missile and drone attacks. President Zelensky noted that these efforts are being hampered by ongoing security threats and constant air raid alerts.
amharic: በኪየቭ ክልል በደረሰ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ እና የ79 ዓመት አዛውንት የፈራረሰ ህንጻ ውስጥ በህይወት ተገኝተዋል። ጥቃቱ 11 ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን፣ በበርካታ የዩክሬን አካባቢዎች የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች አሁንም ቀጥለዋል። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ተደጋጋሚ የአየር ጥቃት ማስጠንቀቂያዎች የነፍስ አድን ስራውን እያስተጓጎሉ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Godina Kiyivitti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Ruusiyaan raawwatteen namoonni 11 erga du'anii booda, daa'imni waggaa torbaafi dubartoonni umriin isaanii 79 ta'e mana diigame keessaa lubbuun baraaramaniiru. Hojiiwwan gargaarsaafi barbaaddaa namoota dhabamanii guutuu Yukreen keessatti itti fufee jira. Pireezidaanti Zelenskii, akeekkachiisni weerara qilleensaafi sodaawwan haaraan hojii oolchuu kana rakkisaa akka godhan ibsaniiru.

title: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
english: San Francisco is experiencing an economic revival driven by the rapid growth of artificial intelligence companies. While this industry influx has boosted local businesses and real estate, it has also sparked concerns about a potential market bubble. Experts and industry workers now worry that a significant drop in AI investments could lead to another painful economic downturn for the city.
amharic: ሳን ፍራንሲስኮ በአርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኩባንያዎች ፈጣን እድገት ምክንያት ኢኮኖሚያዊ መነቃቃትን እያሳየች ትገኛለች። ይህ የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ መስፋፋት በአካባቢው ንግድና የቤት ገበያ ላይ አዎንታዊ ተጽዕኖ ቢኖረውም፣ አንዳንዶች ግን የገበያው ሁኔታ ከመጠን በላይ በማደጉ ምክንያት ሊከሰት የሚችለውን የመውደቅ አደጋ እየፈሩ ነው። በዘርፉ ያሉ ባለሙያዎችና ሰራተኞች፣ በኢንቨስትመንት ላይ የሚኖር ማናቸውም መስተጓጎል በከተማዋ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ሊያደርስ እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው።
oromo: San Fransiskoon guddina ariifataa dhaabbilee hubannoo nama-tolchee (AI) hordofee fayyadamummaa diinagdee argachaa jirti. Guddinni kun carraa hojii uumuu fi gatii gabaa qabeenyaa ol kaasuu danda'us, gabaan kun dafee kan kufuu danda'u ta'uu isaa irratti shakkiiwwan gurguddoon uumamee jira. Oggeeyyinii fi hojjettoonni damee kanaa, investimentiin AI irratti godhamu yoo tasa gadi bu'e, dinagdeen magaalaa sanaa miidhaa cimaaf saaxilamuu akka danda'u sodaatu.

title: Occupied West Bank ‘military zones’ become de facto Israeli settler land
english: Israeli settlers are increasingly occupying areas in the West Bank designated as closed military zones, effectively taking over land that belongs to Palestinian families. These settlers use these sites as bases to harass and assault local farmers, preventing them from accessing their olive groves and ancestral property. Even when the Israeli military permits limited harvesting, the constant threat of violence and restricted access continues to destroy the livelihoods of the Palestinian people.

title: Thousands displaced after deadly storm hits Brazil town
english: A severe supercell storm has caused massive destruction in the Brazilian town of Tupancireta, resulting in at least five deaths. The natural disaster damaged nearly every home in the area, forcing thousands of residents to flee. Currently, approximately 200 military personnel are working on the ground to clear wreckage and assist the affected community.

oromo: Obomboleettiin cimaan magaalaa Tupancireta kan biyya Braazilitti mudate lubbuu namoota shan dabreera. Yeroo ammaa loltoonni 200 ta'an gargaarsa taasisuufi qulqulleessa barbadaa'aa jiru.

title: At least 15 killed in Ukraine’s Kyiv region as Russia intensifies attacks
english: At least 15 people have died following a series of Russian drone and missile strikes across the Kyiv region. One major attack targeted an apartment building in Dymer, while other strikes hit a supermarket and a private residence nearby. Rescue teams are currently working through the debris to locate missing individuals as the conflict intensifies.
amharic: በኪየቭ ክልል በተፈጸሙ ተከታታይ የሩሲያ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ 15 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ከጥቃቶቹ መካከል አንዱ በዲመር ከተማ በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ አፓርትመንት ላይ ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ጥቃቶች ደግሞ በአንድ ሱፐርማርኬት እና መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ ደርሰዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች አሁንም የጠፉ ሰዎችን ፍለጋ በፈራረሱ ህንጻዎች ላይ ስራቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: naannoo Kiyivitti haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi misayilii Raashiyaan gaggeessiteen namoonni 15 ol du’aniiru. Haleellaa kana keessaa tokko mana jireenyaa magaalaa Diyimer keessatti argamu kan rukute yoo ta’u, kan biroo ammoo suuqii fi mana dhuunfaa tokko irratti raawwatameera. Gargaartonni yeroo ammaa bakka diigame keessatti namoota hafan barbaadaa jiru.

title: Gaza turned into ‘toxic wasteland’ by Israel’s war, says new report
english: A recent study indicates that nearly all of Gaza has been severely contaminated by heavy metals, explosives, and biological waste due to the ongoing conflict. This widespread pollution has transformed the region into a toxic environment, posing grave risks to the health of its residents. Experts warn that these environmental hazards will likely threaten the local population and ecosystems for many years to come.
amharic: አዲስ ጥናት እንደሚያመለክተው በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት በአካባቢው 99 በመቶ ላይ ከባድ የብረት ብክለት፣ የፈንጂ ቅሪቶች እና ባዮሎጂካዊ አደጋዎችን አስከትሏል። ይህ ሁኔታ ጋዛን መርዛማ ወደሆነ አካባቢ በመቀየር ለነዋሪዎች ጤና ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ከሆነ እነዚህ የአካባቢ ብክለቶች ለሚቀጥሉት በርካታ አስርት ዓመታት በህዝቡና በአካባቢው ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ያሳድራሉ፡፡
oromo: Qorannoon haaraa tokko akka ibsutti, waraana Gaza keessatti adeemaa jiruun lafti naannichaa guutumaan guutuutti summii, haftee boombii fi balaa bayoloojikaawaan faalameera. Faalama kana hunda hordofee naannichi gara iddoo summiin guuteetti jijjiiramee jiruun, fayyaa jiraattotaaf balaa guddaa fideera. Ogeeyyiin akka akeekachiisanitti, miidhaan naannoo kun waggoota dheeraaf ummataa fi uumama naannichaa miidhuu akka itti fufuuf jira.

title: ‘Extremely concerning’: Inside a US Army plan to detonate Iowa lead stores
english: The U.S. Army intends to proceed with detonating over four tonnes of unstable lead azide at an Iowa military facility, despite a federal court order currently pausing the operation. Officials argue that the controlled explosions are necessary to prevent a spontaneous, dangerous blast due to cold weather, but environmental groups are protesting the potential health risks. Critics are concerned about the release of lead dust, which is toxic and linked to severe long-term health complications.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጦር ኃይል በአዮዋ ግዛት በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ውስጥ የተከማቸ ከ4 ቶን በላይ ያልተረጋጋ የሊድ አዛይድ (lead azide) ንጥረ ነገር በፍንዳታ ለማጥፋት አቅዷል። የፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት ስራውን እንዲያቆም ትእዛዝ ቢሰጥም፣ ጦር ኃይሉ የቅዝቃዜው ወቅት ድንገተኛ ፍንዳታ እንዳያስከትል በማለት እቅዱን ለመፈጸም እየተንቀሳቀሰ ይገኛል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ተሟጋቾች ግን ይህ ድርጊት አደገኛ የሊድ ብናኝ ወደ አየር እንዲለቀቅ በማድረግ በሰዎች ጤና ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ሊያደርስ እንደሚችል በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን እያሰሙ ነው።
oromo: Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyaa Ameerikaa buufata waraanaa Iowa keessatti meettiiwwan 'lead azide' jedhaman kan hanga isaanii toonii afur oli ta'u, ajaja mana murtii irra darbee dhoosuuf qophaa'aa jira. Mootummaan tarkaanfiin kun qilleensa qorraa keessatti dhohiinsa tasaa fi balaa ittisuuf barbaachisaa dha jedhee falma. Haa ta'u malee, gareewwan naannoo eeganii fi namoonni gurguddoon dhohiinsi kun summii 'lead' gara qilleensaa gadi lakkisuun miidhaa fayyaa cimaa uumuu akka danda'u ibsuun mormaa jiru.

title: Poland says Russia tried to assassinate Ukrainian rapper twice
english: Polish authorities have confirmed that Russian intelligence agencies attempted to assassinate Ukrainian-American rapper Albert Vasiliev, known as Kyivstoner, twice in recent months. The first attempt occurred in Poland this past August, leading to the arrest of a suspect recruited by Moscow. A subsequent plot was also uncovered in Denmark, where officials expelled a Russian diplomat and arrested two men for their alleged involvement in the failed attack.
amharic: የፖላንድ ባለስልጣናት የሩሲያ የስለላ ድርጅቶች በዩክሬን-አሜሪካዊው ራፐር አልበርት ቫሲሊዬቭ ላይ ሁለት ጊዜ የግድያ ሙከራ ማድረጋቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። የመጀመሪያው ሙከራ ባለፈው ነሐሴ በፖላንድ የተካሄደ ሲሆን በሞስኮ የተመለመለ አንድ ተጠርጣሪ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ሌላኛው ሴራ በዴንማርክ ተገኝቷል፤ ይህም የዴንማርክ መንግስት አንድ የሩሲያ ዲፕሎማት እንዲባረር እና በጉዳዩ የተሳተፉ ሁለት ግለሰቦች እንዲታሰሩ አድርጓል።
oromo: Mootummaan Pooland akka ibsetti, qaamonni basaastota Raashiyaa gartuu muuziqaa Ukraayinii fi Ameerikaa kan ta'e Albert Vaasiliyeef irratti yeroo lama ajjeechuuf yaalanii turan. Yaaliin jalqabaa baatii Hagayyaa darbe biyya Poolanditti kan fashalaa'e yoo ta'u, namni tokko poolisiin qabameera. Kana malees, biyya Deenmaarkitti yaaliin ajjeechaa biraa kan qindaa'e yoo ta'u, mootummaan Deenmaark dipiloomaata Raashiyaa tokko biyyattii irraa ari'uun, namoota lama ammoo ajjeechaa kana keessatti hirmaatan jechuun hidheera.

title: Libya’s military says ‘fully prepared’ after Benghazi attacks
english: Libyan military forces have stated that they have secured the Benghazi port following recent drone attacks. These strikes targeted both a Russian naval vessel and a separate commercial ship near the eastern coastline. The military authorities remain on high alert and confirm they are ready to address any further security threats.
amharic: የሊቢያ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በቤንጋዚ ወደብ ላይ በተፈጸሙ የድሮን ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ወደቡ በአሁኑ ወቅት ሙሉ በሙሉ ቁጥጥር ስር መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ጥቃቶቹ በሩሲያ የጦር መርከብ እና በሌላ የንግድ መርከብ ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። የሊቢያ ጦር ማናቸውንም ተጨማሪ የጸጥታ ስጋቶችን ለመመከት ሙሉ ዝግጁነት ላይ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል።
oromo: Waraanni Liibiyaa erga mi’a xiyyaaraa kanaan (drone) magaalaa Bengaazii keessatti haleellaan mudatee booda, buufata doonii sana guutummaatti to’annoo jala oolchuu isaa ibseera. Haleellaan kun doonii waraanaa Ruusiyaa fi doonii daldalaa tokko irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Humnoonni waraanaa biyyattii balaa gara fuulduraa kamiyyuu qolachuuf qophii guutuu irra akka jiran beeksisaniiru.

title: Israeli forces continue house demolitions in southern Lebanon
english: Israeli military forces are actively destroying residential properties in the village of Zawtar ash-Sharqiyah located in southern Lebanon. Recent reports confirm that multiple houses have been completely flattened during these ongoing operations. This destruction highlights the deepening impact of military activities on civilian infrastructure in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በምትገኘው ዘውታር አሽ-ሻርቂያ መንደር ውስጥ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን እያፈረሱ ይገኛሉ። በቅርቡ በተደረጉት እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በርካታ ቤቶች ሙሉ በሙሉ መውደማቸው ተረጋግጧል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ ባሉ ሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያሳያል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Zawtar ash-Sharqiyah kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu keessatti manneen jireenyaa diigaa jiru. Hojii waraana kanaa kanaan manneen hedduun guutummaatti barbadaa'uun mirkanaa'eera. Barbadaa'uun manneen kanaa miidhaa gurguddaa bu'uraalee misoomaa sivilii naannichaa irra ga'aa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: WHO chief calls for peace amid heavy fighting in Ebola-hit DR Congo region
english: The head of the World Health Organization is calling for an immediate end to violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after intense fighting disrupted critical Ebola response efforts. Medical teams were trapped inside a hospital maternity ward for over a day, leaving patients and staff in extreme danger. This unrest in the Ituri province severely threatens containment measures for the country's ongoing and deadliest Ebola outbreak.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ዋና ዳይሬክተር በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ በተቀሰቀሰው ከባድ ግጭት ምክንያት የኢቦላ መከላከያ ስራዎች በመስተጓጎላቸው ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። በኢቱሪ ግዛት በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል አካባቢ በተካሄደው ውጊያ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ከአንድ ቀን በላይ በወሊድ ክፍል ውስጥ ተደብቀው ለመቆየት ተገደዋል። ይህ ግጭት ለበሽታው ቁጥጥር ስራዎች ትልቅ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን የታካሚዎችንና የሰራተኞችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል።
oromo: Hogganaan Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa, waraana naannoo Iturii fi biyya Koongoo keessatti mudateen walqabatee, hojiin ittisa dhukkuba Ebola gufachuusaa ibsanii, nageenyi akka bu'u gaafataniiru. Gareen fayyaa tokko waraana kanaan walqabatee sa'aatii 24 oliif mana yaala keessatti harka keessatti dhokachuuf dirqamaniiru. Kuni immoo dhukkuba Ebola to'achuuf carraaqqii taasisaa jiranirratti gufuu guddaa ta'ee fi lubbuu dhukkubsattootaa fi ogeeyyota fayyaa balaaf saaxilee jira.

title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
english: The COP31 climate conference in Turkey concluded without a major agreement due to significant disagreements over fossil fuels and financial support. Many nations and the EU rejected the final proposal because it failed to address the role of oil, gas, and coal in global warming. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres expressed strong disappointment, criticizing the influence of fossil fuel interests on the negotiations.
amharic: በቱርክ የተካሄደው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጅ እና በገንዘብ ድጋፍ ዙሪያ በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ስምምነት ላይ ሳይደርስ ተጠናቀቀ። የመጨረሻው የውሳኔ ሃሳብ የነዳጅ እና የጋዝ አጠቃቀምን በተመለከተ ግልጽ አቋም ባለማንጸባረቁ የአውሮፓ ህብረትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሀገራት ውድቅ አድርገውታል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ጸሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ ድርድር ባለመሳካቱ ያላቸውን ጥልቅ ሃዘን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች በድርድሩ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ማሳደራቸውን ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Gubaa COP31 kan Turkeetti gaggeeffame, dhimma boba'aa fi gargaarsa maallaqaa irratti walii galtee dhabuun xumurame. Biyyoonni hedduu fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa, waliigalteen dhiyoote sun gahee boba'aa (oil, gas, coal) xiqqaachuu waan hin ibsineef fudhachuu didaniiru. Barreessaan Olaanaan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guuteereez, mariin kun milkaa'uu dhabuu isaatti gadda guddaa kan ibsan yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa warra boba'aa oomishanii irratti komii kaasaaniiru.

title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
english: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey concluded without an agreement after record-breaking, extended negotiations. The talks failed because several nations, including the European Union, refused to sign a draft that did not commit to phasing out fossil fuels. Tensions rose as the EU blamed oil-producing states for blocking progress, while Russia publicly criticized the EU's stance.
amharic: በቱርክ ሲካሄድ የነበረው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ ያለ ስምምነት ተጠናቋል። ድርድሩ ከተራዘመ በኋላ ሳይሳካ የቀረው የአውሮፓ ህብረት እና ሌሎች ሀገራት የቅሪተ አካል ነዳጅ አጠቃቀምን ስለመቀነስ በግልፅ ያልጠቀሰውን ረቂቅ ስምምነት በመቃወማቸው ነው። የአውሮፓ ህብረት ዘይት አምራች ሀገራትን ድርድሩን በማስተጓጎል ሲከስ፣ ሩሲያ በበኩሏ የአውሮፓ ህብረትን አቋም በመቃወም ትችት ሰንዝራለች።
oromo: Goggeessi jijjiirama qilleensaa COP31 kan Turkiyitti adeemsifamaa ture, walii galtee tokko malee xumurameera. Mariin kun yeroo dheereffamee booda kan fashale, biyyoonni tokko tokko fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa fayyadama boba’aa (fossil fuels) akka dhaabu kan hin ibsine ta’uu isaa mormuu isaaniitiin. Gamtaan Awurooppaa biyyoota boba’aa oomishan marii kana gufachiisuun yoo komatu, Raashiyaan immoo mormii Gamtaan Awurooppaa qabu cimsitee balaaleffatteetti.

title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
english: Russian airstrikes on a residential building in the Kyiv region have resulted in at least three confirmed deaths, including a woman and a teenager. Rescue teams are working through the debris to find missing individuals, although their efforts are frequently interrupted by ongoing drone threats. Local residents remain deeply distressed as the persistent attacks continue to endanger their lives.
amharic: በኪቭ ክልል በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ላይ በደረሰ የሩሲያ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፈራረሰው ሕንፃ ውስጥ የተጠቁ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ቀጣይነት ያለው የድሮን ማስፈራሪያ ስራቸውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። በአካባቢው የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች የጥቃቱ ሁኔታ ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየከፋ መምጣቱን በመግለጽ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው።
oromo: Humni waraana Raashiyaa ganda naannoo Kiyivitti argamu irratti haleellaa raawwateen hanga ammaatti namoonni sadii du'anii jiru. Ogeeyyonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa caccabaa manichaa keessatti namoota hafan barbaacha jiruus, sodaan haleellaa tirtoonii (drone) deebi'ee mudatu hojii isaanii gufachiisaa jira. Jiraattonni naannichaa haalli waraanaa kun hammaachaa adeemuun isaa baay'ee isaan yaaddessaa akka jiru dubbatu.

title: Netanyahu’s Likud, Eisenkot’s Yashar end coalition talks without deal
english: Negotiations to establish a unity government between Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party have concluded without an agreement. The primary points of contention include who will serve as prime minister and whether far-right minister Itamar Ben-Gvir should be part of the coalition. Although the two parties intend to meet again, Eisenkot is currently considering alternative options to form a government before his deadline expires.
amharic: በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤኒያሚን ኔታንያሁ የሊኩድ ፓርቲ እና በጋዲ አይዘንኮት የያሻር ፓርቲ መካከል ሲደረግ የነበረው የአንድነት መንግስት ምስረታ ድርድር ያለ ስምምነት ተጠናቋል። ድርድሩ የቆመው ማን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር እንደሚሆን እና እጅግ ቀኝ አክራሪው ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በመንግስት ውስጥ ይካተቱ ወይስ አይካተቱ በሚለው አለመግባባት ነው። ሁለቱ ወገኖች ወደፊት ለመገናኘት ቢስማሙም፣ አይዘንኮት የተሰጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ከማለቁ በፊት ሌላ የመንግስት ምስረታ አማራጮችን እየተመለከተ ይገኛል።
oromo: Marii mootummaa tokkummaa hundeessuuf paartii Likeud kan Binyamin Netaaniyaahuu fi paartii Yaashaar kan Gaadii Ayizenkooot gidduutti taasifamaa ture, osoo walii hin galin xumurameera. Wal dhabdeen guddaan eenyutu muummee ministiraa ta'a fi ministirri harka mirgaa Itamaar Ben-Gviir mootumicha keessatti ni hirmaatu moo hin hirmaatan kan jedhuudha. Paartiileen kun gara fuulduraatti marii biraa gaggeessuuf karoorfatanii jiranis, Ayizenkooot yeroon isaa osoo hin ga'in mootummaa hundeessuuf karaa biraa barbaadaa jira.

title: Heartbreak in US capital as Washington Spirit lose women’s football final
english: The Washington Spirit suffered a disappointing 2-1 loss against the Kansas City Current in the National Women’s Soccer League championship. Despite playing at home before a sold-out crowd, the team could not secure the title, marking their third consecutive loss in a final. Although star player Trinity Rodman scored a late goal, the effort was not enough to overcome the deficit.
amharic: የዋሽንግተን ስፒሪት ቡድን በብሔራዊ የሴቶች እግር ኳስ ሊግ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ በካንሳስ ሲቲ ከረንት 2 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት ተሸንፏል። ቡድኑ በሜዳው በደጋፊዎቹ ፊት ቢጫወትም ለሶስተኛ ጊዜ ተከታታይ የፍጻሜ ሽንፈቱን አስተናግዷል። ኮከብ ተጫዋቿ ትሪኒቲ ሮድማን በመጨረሻዎቹ ደቂቃዎች ግብ ብታስቆጥርም ውጤቱን ለመቀልበስ ግን አልቻለችም።
oromo: Garee kubbaa miillaa dubartoota Washington Spirit tapha xumuraa liigii biyyaalessaa irratti Kansas City Current dura 2 fi 1n mo'atameera. Gareen kun bakka buufata isaa fi harka caalu qabattuu irratti taphatus, tapha xumuraa sadan walitti aansuun injifatamee ba'eera. Taphattuun beekamtuun Trinity Rodman daqiiqaa dhumaa irratti goolii tokko lakkoofsistus, injifannoo argachuuf gahaa hin taane.

title: Fire breaks out at popular tourist hotspot in Zanzibar
english: A major fire recently occurred in the popular tourist destination of Nungwi, Zanzibar, damaging several hotels and local businesses. The blaze reportedly started in a hotel bakery oven and quickly spread to nearby structures built with thatched roofs. Fortunately, all tourists were safely evacuated, and no casualties or injuries were recorded.
amharic: በታዋቂው የቱሪስት መዳረሻ በሆነችው የዛንዚባሯ ኑንግዊ ከተማ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ ስድስት ሆቴሎች እና በርካታ ሱቆች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እሳቱ የጀመረው በአንድ ሆቴል መጋገሪያ ምድጃ ውስጥ እንደነበር እና በኋላም ወደ አካባቢው የሳር ክዳን ቤቶች መዛመቱን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። በደረሰው አደጋ ምንም አይነት የሞት እና የአካል ጉዳት ያልደረሰ ሲሆን፣ በሆቴሎቹ የነበሩ ቱሪስቶች በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ መውጣታቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Magalaa turizimii beekamtuu Zanzibar kan taate Nungwi keessatti ibidda ka'een hoteelonni ja'a fi gabaawwan hedduun miidhamaniiru. Ibidni kun kan jalqabe keessumaa bakka daabboo tolfamu tokko keessatti ta'ee, hatattamaanis gara mana jireenyaa fi bakka daldalaa cinaa jiranitti babal'ateera. Gahuu balaa kanaan namni du'e yookiin miidhame hin jiru; turistonni hundi balaa irraa nagayaan baafamaniiru.

title: Liverpool 4-0 Manchester United: Five key takeaways for Pochettino
english: Mauricio Pochettino’s debut as Manchester United manager ended in a disastrous 4-0 defeat against Liverpool at Anfield. The match turned early when defender Lenny Yoro was controversially sent off within the first ten minutes, leading to an immediate opening goal. This result marks the worst start for a new Manchester United manager in a century, leaving the team struggling near the bottom of the Premier League table.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ አዲሱ አሰልጣኝ ማውሪሲዮ ፖቸቲኖ በሊቨርፑል 4 ለ 0 በመሸነፍ አስከፊ ጅምር አድርገዋል። በጨዋታው መጀመሪያ ላይ የተከላካዩ ሌኒ ዮሮ በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ መውጣት ቡድኑን ለሽንፈት ዳርጎታል። ይህ ውጤት ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ ካለፉት 100 ዓመታት ውስጥ ለአዲስ አሰልጣኝ የከፋው የውድድር ዘመን መጀመሪያ ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።
oromo: Leenjisaan Manchestir Yuunayitid haaraan Mawuriisiyo Poochatiinoo injifannoo argachuu osoo hin danda'in tapha jalqabaa isaanii irratti Liivarpuulitti 4 fi 0 mo'atamaniiru. Tapha kana irratti taphataan isaanii Leenii Yooroo daqiiqaa kurnan jalqabaa keessatti kaardii diimaa argatee erga bahee booda, gareen isaanii baay'ee miidhameera. Bu'aan kun immoo seenaa garee Manchestir Yuunayitid keessatti leenjisaa haaraaf jalqaba hammaataa kan ta'e waggaa 100 keessatti mudate dha.

title: Why has the COP31 climate summit failed to reach agreement?
english: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey concluded without a final agreement due to significant disagreements regarding fossil fuels. Several nations most vulnerable to climate change, along with the European Union, rejected the proposed final text. The breakdown reflects deep-seated conflicts over how to address the global transition away from oil, gas, and coal.
amharic: በቱርክ የተካሄደው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆች አጠቃቀም ላይ በተፈጠረ ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት ምክንያት ስምምነት ላይ ሳይደርስ ተጠናቋል። ለአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ከፍተኛ ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ሀገራት እና የአውሮፓ ህብረት የቀረበውን የመጨረሻ ረቂቅ ውድቅ አድርገውታል። የውይይቱ መቋረጥ የዓለም አገራት ከቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆች ወደ ንፁህ ኃይል ሽግግር ለማድረግ ያላቸውን ሰፊ ልዩነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Gubaa'iin jijjiirama qilleensa biyyaa Turkiitti gaggeeffame, dhimma boba'aa lafa keessaa irratti walii galtee dhabuun xumurameera. Biyyoonni jijjiirama qilleensaatiin miidhamoo ta'an fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa qophii dhiyeessii dhumaa irratti waliigaltee didaniiru. Kufaatiin kun gara jijjiirama anniisaa qulqulluutti cehuu irratti biyyoota gidduutti garaagarummaan guddaan jiraachuu isaa kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
english: A Russian vessel docked at a port in Benghazi, Libya, was destroyed by an explosion during what authorities suspect was a drone attack. The ship had stopped for fuel while returning to Russia, and although it caught fire and partially sank, no injuries were reported. Libyan officials are currently investigating the incident to determine who was behind the strike.
amharic: በሊቢያ ቤንጋዚ ወደብ ላይ የነበረ የሩሲያ መርከብ በጥርጣሬ ድሮን ጥቃት ምክንያት ፍንዳታ ደርሶበት ተጎድቷል። መርከቡ ወደ ሩሲያ በሚመለስበት ወቅት ለነዳጅ ማደያ ቆሞ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በእሳቱ ምክንያት በከፊል መስመጡ ቢነገርም ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው እንደሌለ ተገልጿል። የሊቢያ ባለሥልጣናት በጥቃቱ ጀርባ ያለውን አካል ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dooniin Raashiyaa tokko buufata Benghazi kan Liibiyaa keessatti argamuutti erga dhaabatee booda, haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) ta’e jedhamee shakkamuun miidhameera. Dooniin kun gara Raashiyaatti deebi'uuf boba'aa fudhachaa kan ture yoo ta'u, ibidda ka'een erga gubatee booda harki isaa tokko bishaan keessatti liqimfameera; namni miidhame garuu hin jiru. Aangeyyonni Liibiyaa haleellaa kana kan raawwate eenyu akka ta'e qulqulleeffachuuf qorannoo jalqabaniiru.

title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
english: South Korea's Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin has resigned following a major controversy involving cheating on national exams. The government faced public criticism after rushing to implement last-minute anti-cheating measures, including nationwide emergency phone alerts, in response to rising concerns over AI-assisted fraud. Over 100 students were caught with unauthorized devices during the recent college entrance exam, leading the minister to take full responsibility for the administrative failures.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ቾይ ኪዮ-ጂን በሀገሪቱ የፈተና ማጭበርበር ቅሌት ምክንያት ከኃላፊነታቸው ለቀዋል። መንግሥት በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የታገዘ ማጭበርበርን ለመከላከል የወሰዳቸው የችኮላ እርምጃዎች ህዝባዊ ትችት አስከትለዋል። በቅርቡ በተሰጠው የዩኒቨርሲቲ መግቢያ ፈተና ወቅት ከ100 በላይ ተማሪዎች የተከለከሉ መሳሪያዎችን ይዘው በመገኘታቸው፣ ሚኒስትሩ ለችግሩ ሙሉ ኃላፊነት በመውሰድ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri barnoota biyyattii Choi Kyo-jin qormaata biyyoolessaa irratti walqabatee rakkoo gowwomsuu (cheating) uumame hordofee aangoosaanii gadhiisaniiru. Mootummaan teeknoolojii AI fayyadamuun qormaata gowwomsuu ittisuuf tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhachuu isaatiin mormii ummataa mudateera. Qormaata seensa yuunivarsiitii darbe irratti barattoonni 100 ol ta'an meeshaalee seeraan ala ta'an waliin qabamuun isaanii, ministirichi rakkoo sanaaf itti gaafatamummaa guutuu fudhatanii akka gadhiisan taasiseera.

title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
english: A massive fire at a candy factory in Indonesia's Banten province has resulted in at least three confirmed deaths, with dozens of workers currently reported missing. Rescue teams are actively searching the damaged facility where approximately 60 people were believed to be working when the blaze began on Saturday. While 15 survivors have been rescued so far, officials have paused search efforts overnight as they work to determine the cause of the disaster.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ባንተን ግዛት በሚገኝ አንድ ጣፋጭ ምግቦች ማምረቻ ፋብሪካ በተነሳ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ ሰራተኞችም የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። ቅዳሜ እለት እሳቱ ሲነሳ ፋብሪካው ውስጥ ወደ 60 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች እንደነበሩ የሚገመት ሲሆን፣ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሹ ውስጥ ፍለጋቸውን ቀጥለዋል። እስካሁን 15 ሰዎች በህይወት የተረፉ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የእሳት አደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Indoneziyaatti, naannoo Baantaniitti, bakka shukkaaraa fi mi'eessituu oomishu tokkotti ibiddi cimaan ka'een namoonni muraasni lubbuun darbaniru, hojjettoonni hedduunis bakka buutee isaanii dhabameera. Iddoo balaan kun itti ga'e sanatti namoonni 60 ta'an hojjetaa akka turan kan tilmaamamu yoo ta'u, gareen gargaarsa namoottii iddoo sana keessatti barbaacha itti fufaniiru. Namoonni 15 balaa kanaan oolaniiru, aanga'oonnis sababa balaa kanaa ilaalchisee qorannoo jalqabaniiru.

title: Canada’s PM appears next to Trump impersonator at press dinner
english: During a yearly press event in Ottawa, a performer posing as Donald Trump appeared on stage with Mark Carney. The actor used the opportunity to make humorous jokes about both the Canadian Prime Minister and the former American president. This lighthearted moment took place during the Parliamentary Press Gallery Dinner, a gathering known for its satirical take on politics.
amharic: በኦታዋ በተካሄደው ዓመታዊ የጋዜጠኞች የምሳ ግብዣ ላይ፣ እንደ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተለበሰ ተዋናይ ከማርክ ካርኒ ጋር በመድረክ ላይ ቀርቧል። ተዋናዩ የካናዳውን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር እና የአሜሪካውን የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት የሚያፌዙ ቀልዶችን አቅርቧል። ይህ አስቂኝ ክስተት በፖለቲካዊ መሳለቂያዎች በሚታወቀው የፓርላማ ጋዜጠኞች የምሳ ግብዣ ላይ የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Magalaa Ottawaatti qophii waggaa miidiyaalee irratti, namni akka Donald Trump itti uffate tokko Mark Carney waliin mudee irratti argameera. Nama kanaan taphatame kun muummicha ministeeraa Kaanaadaa fi pirezidaantii durii Ameerikaa irratti qoosuun bashannansiiseera. Kunuunis qophii ibsa mootummaa fi gaazexeessotaa kan aadaa qoosatti beekamu irratti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria en route to funeral
english: At least 24 people died after a boat carrying people to a funeral sank in Nigeria. While 24 passengers were successfully rescued, the tragedy appears to have been caused by a mechanical failure. Reports indicate that the boat operator fled the scene after ignoring warnings to head toward safety.
amharic: ናይጄሪያ ውስጥ ለቀብር ሥነ ሥርዓት ሲጓዙ የነበሩ ሰዎች የጫነች ጀልባ በመስጠሟ ቢያንስ 24 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ከዚህ አደጋ 24 ሰዎች በሕይወት መትረፍ የቻሉ ሲሆን፣ አደጋው የተከሰተው በጀልባዋ የቴክኒክ ችግር እንደሆነ ተጠቁሟል። የጀልባዋ ሹፌር ወደ ዳርቻው እንዲሄድ የተሰጠውን ማስጠንቀቂያ ችላ ብሎ ከቦታው በመሰወሩ ተወግዟል።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaa keessatti namoota gara sirna awwaalchaa imalaa turan fe'attee kan turte dooniin tokko galgalaan ishee lubbuun namoota 24 ol darbeera. Namoonni biroon 24 immoo ooluu danda'aniiru. Balaan kun rakkoo teeknikaa doonii sanaa irraa kan madde yoo ta'u, ooftuu dooniichaa garuu gara qarqaraatti akka garagalu gorsa kennameef diduudhaan bakka sanaa baqachuu gabaasni ni mul'isa.

title: Drone attacks kill four near Sudan’s capital, damage UN building
english: Drone strikes attributed to the Rapid Support Forces have resulted in four deaths and multiple injuries in areas surrounding Khartoum, Sudan. The attacks damaged a United Nations office located in a civilian neighborhood and targeted critical infrastructure, including the city's airport. These incidents have sparked urgent concerns regarding the increasing threat that drone warfare poses to humanitarian workers and local residents.
amharic: በሱዳን ዋና ከተማ ካርቱም አካባቢ በተፈጸሙ የድሮን ጥቃቶች አራት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቶቹ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን ቢሮ እና የመንግስት ተቋማትን የጎዱ ሲሆን፣ በሲቪል አካባቢዎች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለው የድሮን ጥቃት ስጋት መፈጠሩን ተከትሎ ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። ጥቃቱ የራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሰስ (RSF) ቡድን እንደፈጸመው ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Humni 'Rapid Support Forces' jedhamu kan shakkamu haleellaan xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (drone) magaalaa Khartoum fi naannawa isheeitti raawwatameen namoonni afur du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun waajjira Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi buufata xiyyaaraa miidheera. Haleellaan kun jireenya namoota nagaa fi hojjettoota gargaarsa namootaa irratti balaa cimaa geessisaa jiraachuu isaatiin yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: The Drugs Don’t Work
english: The documentary 'The Drugs Don't Work' examines the growing crisis of antimicrobial resistance, which threatens to cause millions of deaths annually by 2050 due to antibiotic overuse. It highlights the devastating impact on infant mortality in sub-Saharan Africa while exploring the challenges pharmaceutical companies face in creating new treatments. The film also showcases how global academic research and local innovations are being combined to develop life-saving solutions for this urgent medical threat.
amharic: «The Drugs Don't Work» የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም በፀረ-ተህዋሲያን መድኃኒቶች ላይ የሚፈጠረውን የመከላከል አቅም ችግር ይዳስሳል። መድኃኒቶችን አላግባብ መጠቀም በ2050 ዓ.ም በየዓመቱ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለሞት ሊዳርግ እንደሚችል ያስጠነቅቃል። ፊልሙ በአፍሪካ በተለይም በህፃናት ሞት ላይ ያለውን ተጽዕኖ ከማሳየቱም በላይ የላቦራቶሪ ምርምሮች እና የአካባቢው ፈጠራዎች ይህንን ችግር ለመቅረፍ እንዴት እንደሚረዱ ያብራራል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'The Drugs Don't Work' jedhamu rakkoo qorichoota farra vaayirasii fi baakteriyaa fayyadamuu irratti uumamee fi namoota miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman du'aaf saaxiluu danda'u irratti xiyyeeffata. Rakkoon kun addunyaa irratti, keessattuu Afrikaa keessatti du'a daa'immanii dabaluu isaa fi qorichoonni duraan hojjetan akka hin hojjenne gochuu isaa ibsa. Fiilmichi rakkoo kana furuuf qorannoon saayinsii fi kalaqni haaraan gargaaruu danda'an akkamitti akka fayyadaman ni agarsiisa.

title: Israel kills Palestinian in Deir-el Balah
english: A Palestinian individual was killed following a drone attack by Israeli forces in the central Gaza Strip near Deir al-Balah on Sunday. Separately, an Israeli military operation in Khan Younis resulted in injuries to a young child. These events are part of an ongoing conflict that has claimed more than 1,600 Palestinian lives since the ceasefire agreement of October 2025.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በእስራኤል ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ጋዛ በሚገኘው ዲር አል-ባላህ አቅራቢያ አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ተገድሏል። በሌላ በኩል በካን ዩኒስ በተካሄደ ተመሳሳይ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን አንድ ህጻን መቁሰሉ ተሰምቷል። ከጥቅምት 2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ በእስራኤል ጥቃቶች የሞቱት ፍልስጤማውያን ቁጥር ከ1,600 በላይ ሆኗል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe naannoo Diir al-Balah kan jiru Gaazaatti, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (drone) humnoota Israa'eliin namni Falasxiin tokko ajjeefameera. Gamasa biraatiin, magaalaa Kaan Yuunis keessatti waraanni Israa'el dhukaasa baneen daa'imni tokko madaa'eera. Walitti bu'iinsa kana keessatti waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa bara 2025 booda namoonni Falasxiin 1,600 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru.

title: Why is Turkey warning of an Israeli military operation in Syria?
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has warned that Israel is arming a specific Druze faction in southern Syria to provoke government forces. Ankara believes this strategy is intended to create a justification for Israel to launch a larger military intervention in the region. Turkey has shared these concerns with international partners as a preventive measure to discourage potential Israeli escalation.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሃካን ፊዳን እስራኤል በደቡብ ሶሪያ የሚገኝ አንድ የድሩዝ ቡድን በመሳሪያ በመርዳት የመንግስት ሃይሎችን ለመቀስቀስ እየሰራች ነው ሲሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። አንካራ ይህ አካሄድ እስራኤል በሶሪያ ላይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ለመክፈት ሰበብ ለመፍጠር ያለመ እንደሆነ ታምናለች። ቱርክ ሊከሰት የሚችለውን ግጭት ለመከላከል ሲባል ይህንን ስጋቷን ለአለም አቀፍ አጋሮቿ አሳውቃለች።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Turkey Hakan Fidan, Israa'el gammoojjii kibba Suuriyaatti garee Druze tokko meeshaan gargaaruun loltoota mootummaa raasuuf yaalaa jirti jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Ankara akka amantutti, tarkiinni kun Israa'el Suuriyaatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeessuuf sababa barbaaddachaa jirtu dha. Turkey rakkoo kana dura dhaabbachuuf jecha, yaaddoo ishee kana hiriyoota ishee idil-addunyaa waliin qooddeetti.

title: Israel: Eisenkot and Netanyahu parties meet again for unity government talks
english: Representatives from Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party and Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party recently met to negotiate the formation of a unity government. This discussion comes after a month of political gridlock following an election that left no party with a clear majority. The two sides are attempting to resolve the ongoing impasse, though other major parties were notably absent from these specific talks.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የሊኩድ ፓርቲ እና የተቃዋሚው ጋዲ አይዘንኮት የያሻር ፓርቲ አንድነት መንግስት ለመመስረት በድጋሚ ተወያይተዋል። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው ምንም አይነት ፓርቲ አብላጫ ድምፅ ባላገኘበት ምርጫ ምክንያት ለወራት የቆየውን የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት ለመፍታት ነው። ሁለቱ ወገኖች የቅንጅት መንግስት ለመመስረት ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም እስካሁን ስምምነት ላይ አልደረሱም።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahuu fi mormituun isaanii Gaadii Ayizenkootiin mootummaa tokkummaa hundeessuuf marii irra deebi'anii taa'aniiru. Mariin kun kan gaggeeffame, filannoo booda paartiin tokkollee sagalee caalmaa argachuu dadhabee mootummaan dhaabachuu dhabuu isaa hordofee dha. Gareewwan lamaan kunneen mootummaa gamtaa hundeessuuf yaaliin godhanis ammaaf furmaata hin arganne.

title: Saudi Arabia, Qatar join condemnation of Iran attack on Bahrain
english: Saudi Arabia and Qatar have officially condemned a recent Iranian attack on a civilian industrial site in Bahrain. Both nations expressed their support for Bahrain's security and warned that such aggressive actions threaten the stability of the entire region. This event follows a period of reduced hostility between Iran and several neighboring countries, marking a concerning escalation.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ኳታር በባህሬን የኢንዱስትሪ ማዕከል ላይ ኢራን የፈጸመችውን ጥቃት በይፋ አውግዘዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት የባህሬንን ደህንነት እንደሚደግፉ የገለፁ ሲሆን፣ እንዲህ ያሉ ድርጊቶች የጠቅላላውን አካባቢ ሰላም አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በኢራን እና በጎረቤት ሀገራት መካከል ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ተረጋግቶ የቆየውን ሁኔታ በማወክ ለቀጣናው ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa fi Qatar haleellaa Iraan bu'uuraalee misoomaa Bahreeyin irratti raawwatte balaaleeffataniiru. Biyyoonni lameen kun nageenya Bahreeyin cinaa dhaabbachuu isaanii ibsuun, gochi akkasii nageenya naannichaa guutuu irratti soda akka uumu hubachiisaniiru. Haleellaan kun yeroo dheeraaf Iraanii fi biyyoota ollaa ishee gidduutti tasgabbii uumamee ture booda kan dhufe ta'uu isaan yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Cop31 ends in failure as countries reject climate deal over fossil fuels
english: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey concluded without a final agreement after record-breaking extended negotiations. The deal failed because many nations, including those in the European Union, opposed the lack of clear language regarding fossil fuels and disagreements over climate funding. Consequently, the conference ended in a stalemate, leaving the proposed document unadopted.
amharic: በቱርክ የተካሄደው የCOP31 የአየር ንብረት ጉባኤ ረጅም የድርድር ጊዜ ቢወስድም ስምምነት ላይ ሳይደረስ ተጠናቋል። የአውሮፓ ህብረትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሀገራት በቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆች ላይ ግልጽ የሆነ መግለጫ አለመካተቱ እና በአየር ንብረት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ዙሪያ ባለው አለመግባባት ስምምነቱን ውድቅ አድርገውታል። በመሆኑም ጉባኤው ምንም አይነት የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ሳይተላለፍበት ተቋጭቷል።
oromo: Gubaa'iin jijjiirama qilleensaa COP31 biyya Turkiitti adeemsifamaa ture, mariin yeroo dheeraa fudhate iyyuu walii galtee tokko malee xumurameera. Biyyoonni hedduu fi Gamtaan Awurooppaa, gabaasa dhiyaate keessatti waa'ee boba'aa lafa keessaa ifatti kaasuufi maallaqa jijjiirama qilleensaarratti walii galuu dadhabuun isaanii waliigaltee kana kan fashalsiise dha. Kanaafuu, gubaa'iin kun xumura isaa irratti walii galtee tokko malee xumurameera.
